verdict.rationale: Bento is an LLM/agent observability and improvement platform, so a prompt playground is a fair axis to ask about. However, the evidence never documents an interactive playground for iterating on prompts against real models with variables. The closest items are prompt-change versioning and drift tracking across prompt versions, which are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables
